title: "It stayed alive for so long" - Behind the wheel with the Last Riders saying goodbye to GTA Online, amidst GTA 6's world-changing launch
summary: In the decade or so since Grand Theft Auto Online 's arrival, its roads have become a kind of home; well-loved by its racers, its gear heads, and speed freaks. It's a game that allows players to lose themselves in the roleplay, the heists, and the crime sprees. But for me, an occasional dipper into its major updates, the car folk have always been the engine driving its appeal. Read more

title: GTA 6 Just Can't Stop Breaking Records It Seems
summary: Sets new soundtrack streaming record on Spotify. Not content with being the biggest entertainment launch in history and the highest rated game of all time , GTA 6 has already broken another record.
